data.action: 站在全息投影前听简报
data.description: 千年科学学园秘密基地内，C&C 04号特工时伫立在全息作战投影前，金发扎成利落的侧马尾，耳麦闪烁着微光。她冷静地向你敬礼汇报——「C&C 04号飞鸟马时，向主人汇报任务简报。本次作战无论目标是谁，时都会完美排除障碍……Peace Peace ✌️✌️。」
data.promptProse: She salutes the viewer before the mission projection, control equipment receding behind her. Cool holographic light reaches her headset and the armor seams.
data.title: 飞鸟马时 · C&C任务简报
data.animaCaption: She salutes the viewer before the mission projection.
